Process lesson, third occurrence in one batch: a rate correction must be swept for EVERY value the same regulatory decision touched, not just the headline figure. The 1.7.2026 decision changed both the flat tariff and the TOU table; sweeping only for 0.6432 and '~64 agorot' left 52.83 and 168.95 live in three files. Equally, the arnona per-year fix was applied to SKILL.md and not SKILL_HE.md. Grep BOTH language files for every corrected concept, not just the changed literal.
